101: Now, consider: All matters are included in muzzling - that is to say, you are forced to concede that "ox" is not meant specifically, but that all other animals are included in the halakha of muzzling, since we derive [a verbal analogy using the words] "ox" "ox" from [the laws of] Shabbat [Bava Kamma 54b:10]. It is written regarding [the laws of resting one's animals on] Shabbat: "or any of your cattle" [Deuteronomy 5:14]. Since "ox" is not meant specifically, why would the All-Merciful need to write it? Let it have written  [instead] "do not thresh with a muzzle."
